Bug: a live swarm await_members wait that includes a member whose session has left the swarm registry can only end at its deadline, then it wakes the coordinator with "Timed out. Still waiting on: chipmunk (unknown)". Cause in crates/jcode-app-core/src/server/comm_await.rs: awaited_member_statuses (line ~55) maps a member missing from swarm_members to status "unknown"; line ~78 never counts "unknown" as done (deliberate, keep that: missing never means success); the live loop in spawn_or_resume_await_members (~305-350) exits only on mode_satisfied or deadline. The restart path resume_background_awaits (~772-776) already sets event.wake=false when all members are "unknown"; the live path does not.

Fix goal: when every not-done member is GONE (was present in the registry, then removed), end the wait early as completed=false with a clear summary (e.g. "Ended early: watched members left the swarm: chipmunk. Not confirmed complete.") and wake=false if no member produced anything actionable (notify stays as configured). Missing members must never count as success.

Hard constraint: "unknown" is ambiguous. After reload the registry can be empty until hydration, and resume_background_awaits_missing_peer_waits_for_real_status_after_reload (comm_control_tests/await_recovery_spam.rs) requires such a wait to keep waiting. So do NOT end on plain "unknown". Suggested approach: the watcher tracks session ids it has observed present (seed from the initial statuses in handle_comm_await_members / the first loop pass); a member observed present and later missing is "gone". Never-observed members keep today's behaviour. Also check whether member removal (client_disconnect_cleanup.rs ~373, swarm_persistence.rs ~721, stop path) publishes a swarm event that wakes the watcher loop; if not, the loop would not re-check until the deadline, so make sure removal triggers a re-check (reuse an existing event if one exists; minimal change). Keep the diff small; reuse timeout_summary/finish_await patterns.

Tests (add a new file under comm_control_tests/ following await_late_joiners.rs style, register it like the others): (1) live background wait on 2 members, one completes, the other is removed from swarm_members+swarms_by_id with an event: wait finalizes well before its deadline, completed=false, wake=false, summary names the gone member; (2) a member never present stays pending (existing recovery test must still pass); (3) mode any: one gone, other still running keeps waiting. Mutation-check: revert your fix and confirm test 1 fails.

Run: cargo test -p jcode-app-core await (and comm_control), cargo check -p jcode. Commit only your files with `git commit -- <paths>`, message prefix `fix(swarm):`, push to origin main (no force; pull --rebase on race). Report commit hash, test counts, mutation result, deviations.
